note: Data Volvox uses or could use. Edited by hand or by the AI researcher. Prices are NOT written here from memory: 'to check' means verify on the provider's own page before deciding.

items.name: Own-server recorder: order book, funding, liquidations
items.why: Live depth and flow cannot be downloaded later; it becomes the long-term pattern mine (in the Data Vault).

items.name: Hyperliquid: top 50 accounts and candles
items.why: Shows what the largest on-chain traders hold; recorded hourly since Nov 9.

items.name: Deribit options (skew, volatility)
items.why: Options fear and positioning; snapshots every 30 minutes.

items.name: News headlines (9 feeds) and the AI market brief
items.why: Event shocks such as hacks, rule changes and big announcements.

items.name: Coinalyze: liquidations and cross-exchange funding / open interest
items.why: Forced selling and crowding across Binance, Bybit and OKX.

items.name: CFTC Commitments of Traders (weekly)
items.why: How big institutions are positioned in futures; slow but a different kind of evidence.

items.name: Bybit and OKX own funding and open-interest history
items.status: collecting (OKX only; Bybit refuses GitHub's machines, its numbers arrive via Coinalyze)
items.why: Crowding outside Binance; free public endpoints.

items.name: DefiLlama: TVL, DEX volume, stablecoin chains
items.why: Real money moving on-chain, per sector.

items.name: Spot ETF flows (daily)
items.cost: free page; terms of use to check
items.why: Large, slow money in and out of Bitcoin and Ether.

items.name: Prediction-market odds (Polymarket)
items.why: The crowd's odds on rate decisions and elections, a macro read.

items.name: Tick-level order-book history
items.why: Years of microstructure for sniper entries; only worth it if the recorder shows depth matters.

items.name: On-chain analytics suite (exchange flows, holder cohorts)
items.why: Deeper long-side evidence than the free on-chain feed; weigh only after the long contestants show where the gap is.

items.name: Social and sentiment data
items.why: Crowd mood; noisy, so it would enter only as a contestant.

items.name: BTC / ETH dominance and total market cap (hourly)
items.why: Market-wide risk-on / risk-off and alt-season context, recorded hourly because it cannot be downloaded later.
